# Changelog

The changelog is maintained in
[`NEWS.md`](https://github.com/JoshuaAmmons/didgpu/blob/main/NEWS.md)
in the package source. The chapter below is auto-rendered from that
file on every build of the docs site.

```{r changelog, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
news_path <- file.path(rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_r_package), "NEWS.md")
if (file.exists(news_path)) {
  txt <- readLines(news_path, warn = FALSE)
  # Strip the top-level "# NEWS" heading if present so it doesn't duplicate
  # the page's H1.
  if (length(txt) && grepl("^# NEWS$", trimws(txt[1]))) txt <- txt[-1]
  cat(paste(txt, collapse = "\n"))
} else {
  cat("_(NEWS.md not found at build time — falling back to GitHub.)_\n")
}
```
